outcome: neurodevelopmental impairment (NDI) at 18-24 months corrected age (CA)
composite outcome of death or NDI
cohort: The study included preterm infants with a gestational age of <=28 weeks born between January 2009 and June 2018.
finding: Initial hemoglobin <120 g/L at birth was not associated with neurodevelopmental impairment at 18-24 months corrected age among survivors, although the composite outcome of death or NDI was significantly higher in the low hemoglobin group.
